newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Sonae to open eight hypermarkets in Brazil.
newsitem.headline: Sonae to open eight hypermarkets in Brazil.

text.p: The retail arm of Portugal's Sonae Investimentos, Sonae Distribuicao, plans to open eight hypermarkets in Brazil to double its Brazilian sales to 173 billion escudos by 1998, managing director Edgar Pinto Ribeiro told the daily "Diario Economico".
He said the investment, in southern Brazil, would amount to 8.5 billion escudos.
One of the eight new hypermarkets already opened in the state of Santa Catarina in September and a second is due to start business in January.

Pinto Ribeiro said Sonae Distribuicao, which is active in Brazil through its subsidiary Companhia Real de Distribuicao (CRD), aimed to be among Brazil's top four retailers. It is currently the eighth largest.
He said the company hoped to move into central and northern Brazil by acquiring, or reaching an association agreement with, a local retail chain.
He said this would take place in 1997 but gave no further details.
CRD has 25 outlets, including two hypermarkets, and expects sales this year of 86 billion escudos.
